name: Appraise Monster
body:
You can substitute Appraise for any Knowledge skill when making a monster lore check. When you succeed at a monster lore check, you also learn the strength of the monster’s aura (its CR) and current bonus it has (if any) to save against capture monster. You still add your favored enemy bonus to this check if able.
